profile.name: Jyothi Siddalingappa Jayanna
profile.title: AI Platform and DevOps Engineer
profile.summary: M.Sc. Web Engineering student at TU Chemnitz with 3+ years of professional experience as an AI Platform and DevOps Engineer at A.P. Moller–Maersk. Skilled in Java and Spring Boot backend engineering, Kubernetes on Azure, CI/CD automation, and LLM-driven AI workflows using LangChain, Ollama, and RAG. Internal platform tooling she contributed to is used by 8,000+ engineers. Available immediately for a working student role in Cloud, DevOps, AI, or Software Engineering, up to 20 hours per week, and open to relocation.

experience.role: Platform Engineer, Internal Developer Platform (IDP) team
highlights: Built Java, Spring Boot, and Temporal backend workflows for deployment validation and service onboarding on an internal platform used by 8,000+ engineers.
Independently developed a Temporal-based deletion workflow within one month to remove service integrations and Kubernetes resources.
Developed the Maersk Application Catalog and a GitHub integration service for automated repository creation and CI template configuration.
Co-maintained MTTS synchronization across Azure, GitHub, and team spaces, and operated and troubleshot Azure Kubernetes clusters.
Co-maintained CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Docker, and Kubernetes, and operated Harbor and SonarQube in Kubernetes clusters.
Independently created an ARM-based GitHub self-hosted runner and contributed to the organization’s migration from Azure DevOps to GitHub.
Resolved 1,000+ Level 2/3 incidents, received the Maersk SPOT Award, wrote Python automation scripts, and ran bi-monthly onboarding sessions.
Assisted with CI/CD, deployments, monitoring checks, and production incident triage using Docker, Kubernetes, and Azure DevOps.
Advanced from Alpha to Beta milestone and organized technical workshops on Java, web development, and cloud computing.
Completed hands-on Azure assignments and received the Best Mentor award.

experience.role: Digital Nurture 2.0 Certified Skill Development Trainee
highlights: Completed Java and Spring Boot assignments on object-oriented design and received the Digital Tech Knight award.
